title: PPM Learning-Layer Contracts
description: Structures for the three-layer intelligence model: feature records emitted by the deterministic layer (the feature store and ML input), per-task computation profiles that route requests, training examples assembled from features + human labels + outcomes, and shadow-evaluation records that gate a learned model's promotion.

FeatureValue.description: A single computed feature. Typed so the same record serves dashboards and models without skew.

FeatureRecord.description: One deterministic computation, versioned and entity-linked. Emitted by the deterministic layer; consumed by dashboards now and model training later.

deterministic_fn.description: The pure function that produced this, for traceability.

fn_version.description: Bump when the formula changes so downstream examples can be re-derived.

inputs_hash.description: Hash of the source data points, for cache/invalidation alignment.

TaskComputationProfile.description: Per-task routing config: which layer serves it, its feature spec, and whether it may graduate to a learned model.

mode.description: 'deterministic' never calls a model; 'hybrid' computes a core then generates a surface; 'generative' needs the LLM.

deterministic_first.description: Router tries the deterministic core before any cache/model tier.

feature_metrics.description: The FeatureRecord metrics this task reads/emits.

graduation_eligible.description: May a learned model eventually serve this task's generative part?

promotion_agreement.description: Shadow-agreement threshold required before a learned model is promoted.

TrainingExample.description: One row of a per-task versioned dataset. Features (from the deterministic layer) + the served output + the human label + the eventual outcome. Assembled passively from normal use.

features.description: Captured identically at train and serve time — no skew.

label.description: The human verdict from AI_FEEDBACK — the true target.

outcome_value.description: What actually happened (sprint hit goal? risk materialized?), joined at time T+n.

ShadowEvaluation.description: A candidate learned model run against live traffic without serving. Gates promotion to the cascade.

agreement.description: Rate at which the shadow output matched the served/human-accepted output.

regressions.description: Cases where the shadow model would have been worse — reviewed before promotion.
